freeze_context.user_feedback: C29 five mode switches and three video replays reported normal; preserve C29 source/bit as frozen reference.
freeze_context.interpretation: This audit recommends only future C30 changes in its independent candidate. It makes no C29 source, bitstream, or package changes.

preserve_product_behavior.behavior: Internal tone selection and WAV audio playback
preserve_product_behavior.implementation: player_adjust_control.tone_press -> player_video_source_probe.tone_toggle -> player_audio_probe.tone_mode mux; wav_pcm_bridge, tone generator, audio_valid/audio data and ACR outputs feed HDMI audio input.
preserve_product_behavior.recommendation: Keep tone event path, tone generator, WAV bridge, audio mux, and HDMI audio interface. Rename debug_tone_press/debug_tone_mode/probe_tone_toggle to functional names in C30 if touching these nets.

preserve_product_behavior.implementation: player_video_source_probe.rgb_out returns raw BMP RGB only when bmp_valid, otherwise black; probe_mode is reset low and key0_n_async is tied high at the top, so its test-pattern toggle request is unreachable in this integration.
preserve_product_behavior.recommendation: Keep equivalent gate: vout_data_base = osd_frame_valid ? vout_data_raw : 24'h000000. Remove the probe wrapper, unreachable probe-mode state/test-pattern mux, unused key0_active output, and its constant-high synchronizer input. Preserve dynamic text overlay; its probe_mode label input can be tied low or removed while retaining timer/text behavior.

preserve_product_behavior.implementation: player_adjust_control drives short next/auto requests, long-press mode/brightness/contrast/tone events and chord events for waveform/video mode. Its debug_state is a read-only packed snapshot.
preserve_product_behavior.recommendation: Keep the complete control classifier and event outputs. Remove only debug_state output/adjust_debug_state wire when diagnostic pages are removed. Keep key1/key2 top-level pins and the mailbox/ack paths.

preserve_product_behavior.implementation: player_audio_probe owns LED sticky-event bits and half-second tone-mode blink; led is a top-level physical output.
preserve_product_behavior.recommendation: Keep LED behavior and required state. Do not delete player_audio_probe as one unit. If the product no longer needs a given LED indication, remove that indicator only after explicitly changing the intended LED behavior.

remove_candidates.evidence: All outputs only feed diagnostic pages 5/6; its state never feeds video, memory, SD, audio, or reset control.
remove_candidates.control_impact_basis: The probe consumes tapped read/write/status signals and only emits page values. No output has a control consumer. Keep the underlying frame buffer operational signals and remove only diagnostic taps/logic.

remove_candidates.evidence: CRC/count outputs feed page display and snapshots only; audio_valid/audio_left/audio_right are observed in parallel.
remove_candidates.control_impact_basis: No CRC output returns to the WAV bridge, audio mux, HDMI core, or any player state machine. pcm_count_snapshot is assigned but never consumed and is dead source state.

remove_candidates.evidence: It decodes the already-generated TMDS channel buses; outputs are only status-page fields.
remove_candidates.control_impact_basis: No monitor output fans into TMDS generation, ACR calculation, audio validity, video validity, reset, or playback control.

remove_candidates.evidence: The chain selects diagnostic/version words and serially drives the 595 display. Top-level seg7 pins have no control consumers.
remove_candidates.control_impact_basis: Removing the page mux/595 path leaves the media and key state machines without inputs changed. The board's numeric diagnostic feedback and version display are lost.

remove_candidates.location: SD/sd_card_cmd.v read_crc16/read_crc_hi/read_crc_checked/read_crc_bad observer block; sd_card_top outputs and top page-2 sync/page display
remove_candidates.control_impact_basis: The source comment marks CRC16 as passive; the comparator only increments read_crc_bad and does not gate data delivery, SPI transaction completion, or the read FSM. The complete sd_card_cmd parent must remain.

remove_candidates.candidate: Top-level diagnostic counters/registers unused by media control
remove_candidates.evidence: These state values only populate a diagnostic page or have no consumer. wav_first_wait_* and wav_fifo_lowwater have no read consumer in the audited top; synthesis may already remove them.
remove_candidates.control_impact_basis: Their only observed endpoints are status registers/pages; no feedback into audio sample_take, file reads, key control, or reset.

remove_candidates.evidence: Ports are assignments/taps for u_memory_runtime_probe and status pages. Keep their underlying operational nets where they drive the frame logic; remove only debug port aliases after deleting the observers.
remove_candidates.resource_from_gate_area: Included in u_memory_runtime_probe and possible top/frame-buffer flattening; no isolated port cost is reported.

remove_candidates.candidate: status-only debug buses and output ports
remove_candidates.evidence: Their only consumers are page assembly, synchronization for display, or unused diagnostics after status chain removal.
remove_candidates.control_impact_basis: The producers' operational outputs remain connected to the same media controller; discard only status outputs/aliases.

carries the tone selection event into player_audio_probe.tone_mode.
actual selected audio source state; consumed by PCM waveform renderer and packet monitor tone checking, as well as diagnostic context.
names are diagnostic; only status/debug monitor taps. They do not control playback in top.
read-only instrumentation taps, safe removal after removing dependent observer.
despite the module name, implements the pixel-valid black gate in addition to an unreachable test pattern; preserve the gate, remove the wrapper/test-only branch.

area_notes.not_an_attribution: These are per-instance hierarchy area values from the C29 gate report; synthesis may share, flatten, or remove logic after edits, so C30 needs a fresh build before claiming actual savings.
area_notes.video_source_probe: No separate u_video_source_probe row appears in this gate hierarchy report. Its key synchronizer/test-pattern path is constant or optimized in the integrated build; only source inspection confirms the surviving functional valid gate requirement.

recommended_c30_cut_order: Remove u_packet_monitor, u_pcm_crc_probe, and u_memory_runtime_probe plus their diagnostic-only CDC/snapshot buses.
Remove SD CRC observer counters and output plumbing if status page 2 and CRC reports are retired; keep sd_card_cmd read/command operation intact.
Remove C29 compact status pages and status_hex595 when C30 no longer needs serial numeric diagnosis; this also removes the segment output display behavior.
Replace u_video_source_probe with the direct RGB valid gate and delete its unreachable test-pattern/key0 state.
Trim diagnostic-only audio status if desired while preserving the documented tone/WAV selection, ACR/LED behavior, and event semantics.
validation_limits: Static connectivity and existing C29 area report only; no equivalence proof for a future C30 edit.
Area savings are expected from hierarchy counts, not guaranteed post-synthesis values.
C29 five switches/three replays are user-reported and treated as freeze context, not independently retested in this audit.
